title: Azure Event Grid connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One Event Grid connector instance's settings, read by the native cloud family (`loams_connector_cloud::event_grid`, CN2 Task 19): a topic endpoint or a namespace topic for the sink, and a webhook or a namespace subscription's pull delivery for the source. `auth.key`, `auth.client_id`, `auth.client_secret` and `auth.webhook_key` hold the **names** of secrets (D189) and are exactly the manifest's `secrets` list; `auth.tenant_id` and `auth.authority` are not secret. See docs/guides/connectors/azure-event-grid.md.

endpoint.description: Sink: a topic endpoint (the CloudEvents schema).

namespace_endpoint.description: Sink or pull source: a namespace endpoint, with `topic`.

topic.description: The namespace topic (sink or pull source); for the webhook source, the resource name events carry.

subscription.description: Pull source: the namespace topic's event subscription.

delivery.description: Source: `webhook` (Event Grid pushes to the instance's route) or `pull` (a namespace subscription).

auth.description: A topic or namespace access key (the `key` auth slug), or Entra ID client credentials (`aad`); and the webhook source's key.

key.description: The name of the secret holding the topic's access key (sent as aeg-sas-key) or the namespace's (SharedAccessKey). Resolved through the secret store (D189); never stored in the instance.

client_id.description: Entra ID: the name of the secret holding the client id. Resolved through the secret store (D189); never stored in the instance.

client_secret.description: Entra ID: the name of the secret holding the client secret. Resolved through the secret store (D189); never stored in the instance.

authority.description: Entra ID: the authority, for sovereign clouds.

webhook_key.description: Webhook source: the name of the secret a request must carry as its `code` query parameter. Resolved through the secret store (D189); never stored in the instance.

lock_seconds.description: Pull source: the lock; it is renewed at half this while an event waits for the Fabric.

max_wait_seconds.description: Pull source: how long a receive waits.

receivers.description: Pull source: receive loops run in parallel.
